title: state.changed
description: The app's declared state changed. A tool's result or an outside fact caused it, and the cause says which; the whole state travels so a reader never needs the previous entry.

StateChanged.description: The app's declared state changed. A tool's result or an outside fact caused it, and the cause says which; the whole state travels so a reader never needs the previous entry.

state.description: The app's state after the change, whole, as the app declares it: its fields are the object's fields.

changed.description: The names of the fields that changed.

cause.description: What changed it, when the platform knows: the tool whose result moved a field, or the outside fact the app's handler acted on.

StateCause.description: What changed the state: a tool's result, or a fact from outside. Told apart by kind.

StateCauseTool.description: A tool call's result changed the state.

call_id.description: The call id of the tool.call.

StateCauseEvent.description: A fact from outside changed the state: the app's handler for an event.received moved a field.

seq.description: The seq of the event.received entry.
